company.shortDescription: Royal is a developer of an NFT-based music platform used to allow buy ownership in songs.
company.description:
Royal is a developer of an NFT-based music platform used to allow buy ownership in songs. It also allows artists to create their music and convert it to non-fungible tokens (NFT) and sell them by using limited digital assets (LDA) technology that enables fans to invest in artists and earn royalties alongside them.

The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $55,000,000, or 77.46% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,612,515 to $475,599,474, a 49.48x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
